monday.later: Evening gym: Hack Squat 4×10–15 · Negative Pull-ups 3×3–5 · Leg Press 3×10–15 · Chest-Supported Row 3×8–12 · Leg Extension 3×12–15 · Face Pull 2×15–20 · 45° Back Extension 3×10–15 · Zone 2 20–25 min. Back extensions go after strength work and before cardio.

wednesday.label: Wednesday
wednesday.focus: Pelvic/hip stability + core + assisted L-sit progression

steps.title: 360° breathing + pelvic floor
steps.details: About 5 slow 360° breaths, then 5 × 3 s submaximal pelvic-floor lifts. After every lift, spend 6–8 s genuinely releasing before the next rep.
steps.setup: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat. Keep a comfortable neutral low back. Inhale into lower ribs, belly and back rather than only the upper chest.
steps.feel: For the lift: a gentle inward-and-upward pelvic-floor action. For the release: stop lifting, inhale calmly and let the area soften/widen. The release should feel different from continuing to hold.
steps.avoid: Do not squeeze the glutes, brace the whole abdomen hard, keep the pelvic floor clenched between reps, or actively push/bear down to relax.
steps.minuteCue: Check the contrast: lift → completely stop lifting → inhale and soften.

steps.title: Mountain climbers
steps.details: 3 × about 30–35 s with brief easy breathing between rounds. Keep the trunk controlled rather than racing.

steps.title: REST / set Copenhagen support
steps.details: Use a stable bench/table at a comfortable height.

steps.title: Knee-supported Copenhagen plank
steps.details: 2–3 × 20–30 s/side. Support the TOP leg at the knee on the bench/table. Keep both knees bent if that is the strongest clean version for now. This short-lever version is the current working level.
steps.setup: Forearm under shoulder. Top knee supported on the bench/table; lower leg can stay bent underneath. Lift the pelvis so shoulder, hip and supported knee form a strong line.
steps.feel: Strong inner-thigh/adductor work on the supported leg plus side-core tension.
steps.avoid: Do not let the pelvis sag or rotate. Do not rush to the foot-supported version. When 3 × 30 s is clean, gradually move the support farther down the shin before progressing toward the ankle/foot.
steps.minuteCue: Switch side or reset for the next quality hold.

steps.title: REST
steps.details: Stay on the mat for side plank.

steps.title: Knee-supported side plank leg raise
steps.details: 3 sets/side. Keep the BOTTOM knee on the floor. Sets 1–2: raise the top leg with the knee bent if needed. Set 3: try 6–10 controlled reps with the top leg straight.
steps.setup: Bottom forearm under shoulder, bottom knee bent on the floor. Keep hips stacked. The upper leg moves from the hip without rolling the pelvis backward.
steps.feel: Side core and outer hip/glute medius working hard while the trunk stays still.
steps.avoid: Do not chase the full side-plank-from-feet version yet. Stop the set when the pelvis starts dropping or rotating.
steps.minuteCue: Reset your stacked pelvis; use the straight-leg version only while form stays clean.

steps.title: Single-leg DB deadlift — opposite hand
steps.details: 3 × 8–10/side. Hold the dumbbell in the OPPOSITE hand from the standing leg: right leg down → dumbbell in left hand, and vice versa.
steps.setup: Keep a soft bend in the standing knee. Push the hips backward while the free leg reaches long behind you. Keep the pelvis square to the floor. It is fine to lightly touch a wall/table with the free hand for balance.
steps.feel: Main stretch/load in the hamstring and glute of the standing leg.
steps.avoid: Do not open the pelvis to the side or reach for the floor at the expense of a neutral spine. Range ends when hamstring tension or balance limits clean form.
steps.minuteCue: Think hips back, square pelvis, long spine — balance is secondary to loading the standing hamstring.

steps.title: REST
steps.details: Move to the mat for dead bug.

steps.title: DB pullover dead bug
steps.details: 2–3 × 6–8/side. Start with the dumbbell held in both hands directly ABOVE THE CHEST. As one leg extends/lowers, slowly move the dumbbell behind the head only as far as you can keep the ribs and abdomen controlled. Return both toward the start and alternate legs.
steps.setup: Lie on your back, hips and knees around 90°. Arms start straight above the chest. Use a modest dumbbell.
steps.feel: Front abs/deep core resisting extension while the arm and opposite-leg levers lengthen.
steps.avoid: For now, do not hold the dumbbell permanently far behind the head while lowering both legs together like a weighted hollow-body leg lower. That is a later progression. Stop/regress if the abdomen domes/cones or the low back takes over.
steps.minuteCue: One leg at a time; dumbbell travels chest → controlled behind-head range → chest.

steps.title: REST / set yoga blocks
steps.details: Place the blocks securely beside the hips.

steps.title: Assisted L-sit progression on yoga blocks
steps.details: Current level: support hold + one-leg tuck. First press hard into the blocks and practise lifting the hips with both feet still available for support. Then keep one foot lightly on the floor while lifting the other knee into a tuck for 5–10 s; alternate sides. If that becomes solid, progress to both toes barely assisting, then brief full-tuck attempts.
steps.setup: Blocks beside the hips, shoulders pushed down away from ears, elbows straight. Lean slightly forward as needed to get the hips light.
steps.feel: Triceps, shoulders, abs and hip flexors working together. The current assisted version should already feel challenging.
steps.avoid: Do not force both feet off the floor just because the exercise is called an L-sit. Do not hold your breath or let the shoulders collapse upward.
steps.minuteCue: Quality progression: support hold → one-leg tuck → toe-assisted tuck → only later full tuck.

steps.title: Downshift breathing
steps.details: Finish with calm breathing and deliberately let the pelvic floor and abdominal wall stop gripping.

thursday.later: Evening gym: Pull-ups/Assisted 4×4–8 · DB/Cable Row 3×10–12 · Rear-Delts 2×15–20 · DB Cyclist Squat 3×8–12 · Bulgarian Split Squat 3×8–10/side · Leg Extension 2–3×12–15 · Seated Hamstring Curl 3×10–15 · 45° Back Extension 3×10–15 · Intervals 8–10 min + Zone 2 10–15 min. Back extensions go after strength work and before cardio.
